items.reason: Five real answers on four occasions, each to a question a member really asked, ending on the host's plug for a pastebin: no aired segment has this build, order or ending, and the guest has not been in an aired episode (the thread behind the first exchange was performed only in an unaired draft, which blocks nothing). The three points from round 1 are gone. No line, title, tag or count says how long anything took; the delivery line is cut, the maker's own second sentence now says what was made, and the laugh follows the host's line about himself, so nothing is staged as an ask, a wait and an arrival. No animal call is played and there is no roll call. There is no board, no list and no empty place that fills, so the picture and payoff this script shared with the song are no longer here. What remains for the final review: the still sketch of the video (four heads and a fifth voice marked as the cat) comes up on the answer's second sentence and must stay an illustration with nothing arriving; with the song in the same rundown the cat story is told twice, here in one plain sentence and one answer, and the band member who hums the yowl here is the one who sings the cat there; the parody answer under the guest's own label is still the episode's one joke about the show itself; three of the five questions were first asked by an account that spoke in the previous episode, and the host asks them as a member's, unnamed and unshown.
